item.text: The pager stops when the returned `items` count is below the requested limit. The gateway filters deleted rows after selecting its storage window, so an active/deleted pair looks like a short final page even when a continuation bookmark exists. I’ll make pagination follow the bookmark until it is `null`, and add the reported sparse-page case as a regression test.

Fixed pagination so the export follows each continuation bookmark until the gateway returns `null`. Deleted records can no longer make a nonfinal page look like the end of the scan.

Added a regression test for the `i-1`, deleted `i-2`, `i-3` invoice case. I did not run tests.
